problem_en: Build an open-source telemetry discrepancy estimator: 1) an optional same-origin pageview beacon that sends only after explicit analytics consent, 2) a Python log analyzer that compares server and client event counts, and 3) guidance for interpreting discrepancies. Privacy Respect: Script strictly measures aggregated loss metrics without tracking personal identifiers or circumventing client browser privacy settings.
